items.evidence: Self-test passes in both projects (also 100/100 per project in the 50x run). Holdout: stress copies with an injected random 0-4000 MessageChannel-hop worker-reply delay and a 15 ms pause after the helper's count read, run in WebKit 30x each. OLD helper (base 3637e36): 2/30 failed with 'a bot is to act / Received: null', the CI signature. FIXED helper: 30/30 passed. Reading the test: it asserts not.toBeNull and >= 400 for both samples, so it can fail.

The start-up loop steps runFor(1) until the count is > 0, then asserts count toBe(2) and seat 3 'To act'. It passes 100/100 per project. Holdout mutant (an extra 450 fake ms after the deal, so seat 3 acts during start-up): fails in both projects with 'only the blinds are posted, Expected 2, Received 3'. The new assertions catch a start-up overrun.

The guard passes in both projects (100/100 per project in the 50x run, and in the full suite). Holdout: a guard copy that requires exactly 8 samples, run under injected worker latency with a 40 ms pause, 15x per project. OLD helper: 30/30 failed with 5 or 7 samples recorded (silently dropped samples). FIXED helper: 30/30 passed with all 8 samples.
